outcome: Maternal morbidity (bladder injury, iliac vein injury)
cohort: 70 patients suspected to have placenta accreta between January 2017 and June 2019 at Haji Adam Malik Hospital, Indonesia
finding: Out of 52 confirmed cases of placenta accreta, hysterectomy was associated with bladder injury (5.8%), iliac vein injury (4.8%), and two mortalities (4.8%).
